fields.name: encounter_id
fields.quality_rule: Detect and quarantine duplicate encounter IDs during data-quality processing

fields.name: facility_id
fields.quality_rule: Validate against the facility registry; quarantine unknown facility references

fields.name: district_id
fields.quality_rule: Validate against the configured Bangladesh district registry

fields.name: age
fields.quality_rule: Flag ages outside 0-120 and quarantine invalid values

fields.name: icd10_code
fields.quality_rule: Validate codes against configured disease-code groups

validation_rules: Duplicate encounter IDs must be detected, counted, and quarantined during data-quality processing
Required fields must not be null or empty
onset_date must not be later than report_date
onset_date and report_date must fall within the configured simulation period
reporting delay must be between 0 and 21 days
facility_id must be checked against the facility registry
district_id must match a valid configured Bangladesh district identifier
age outside the expected range must be flagged by data-quality checks
sex must match one of the configured allowed values
outcome must match one of the configured allowed values
ICD-10 codes must be checked against the configured disease-code groups
Boolean fields must contain valid boolean values
